description: Detects API keys, passwords, tokens, and credentials embedded directly in source code. Use when writing code that contains API keys, passwords, tokens, connection strings, or private keys as string literals. Also invoke when embedding credentials in configuration files, environment setup scripts, or test fixtures that could be committed to version control.
